name: Tiling With M * 1 Tiles
statement:
1. You are given a number n and a number m separated by line-break representing the length and breadth of a m * n floor.
2. You've an infinite supply of m * 1 tiles.
3. You are required to calculate and print the number of ways floor can be tiled using tiles.
inputFormat:
A number n
A number m
outputFormat: A number representing the number of ways in which the number of ways floor can be tiled using tiles.
